neighbours.label: the word that completes a statement about a class of things: its number, existence or instances (casualties were ⟦few⟧; how many X are ⟦there⟧; an example of X ⟦is⟧; the first X ever ⟦made⟧; a common ⟦one⟧); quiet on the same words in ordinary use (a few people, he made, is leaning)
fire: Nobody could tell me how many irregular verbs are there in Spanish.
